metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2022 · Wednesday
metas.description: Follows Wednesday Addams' years as a student, when she attempts to master her emerging psychic ability, thwart a killing spree, and solve the mystery that embroiled her parents.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2026 · A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
metas.description: A century before the events of "Game of Thrones," Ser Duncan the Tall, and his squire, Egg, wander through Westeros while the Targaryen dynasty rule the Iron Throne. Great destinies and enemies await the incomparable friends.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2022 · Andor
metas.description: In an era filled with danger, deception, and intrigue, Cassian Andor embarks on a path that is destined to turn him into a Rebel hero.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · The Sandman
metas.description: Upon escaping after decades of imprisonment by a mortal wizard, Dream, the personification of dreams, sets about to reclaim his lost equipment.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · 3 Body Problem
metas.description: A fateful decision made in 1960s China reverberates in the present, where a group of scientists partner with a detective to confront an existential planetary threat.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2025 · It: Welcome to Derry
metas.description: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · All of Us Are Dead
metas.description: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out or turn into one of the rabid infected.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Interview with the Vampire
metas.description: A vampire tells his epic story of love, blood, and the perils of immortality to a journalist.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 2022 · Alchemy of Souls
metas.description: Set in a fictional country called Daeho, it is about the love and growth of young mages as they overcome their twisted fates due to a forbidden magic spell known as the "alchemy of souls", which allows souls to switch bodies.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2023 · Death's Game
metas.description: Facing hardships and contemplating suicide after a series of setbacks, a man is confronted by Death and tasked with experiencing death over and over again through 13 other lives to earn the chance to live.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2025 · Legend of Zang Hai
metas.description: Set in a legendary ancient time China, a man works in ruling government dedicates to civilian lives

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2024 · One Hundred Years of Solitude
metas.description: In the timeless town of Macondo, seven generations of the Buendía family navigate love, oblivion and the inescapability of their past and their fate.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · My Demon
metas.description: A pitiless demon becomes powerless after getting entangled with an icy heiress, who may hold the key to his lost abilities -- and his heart.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2023 · Lucky Guy
metas.description: The series dives into the strange life of Lucky, a college student who appears to have it all since birth, but now his luck has become a bane as he is faced with some of the most difficult situations of his life.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · School Spirits
metas.description: Maddie, a teen stuck in the afterlife investigating her own disappearance, goes on a crime-solving mission as she adjusts to high-school purgatory.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2023 · Oshi No Ko
metas.description: A doctor and his recently-deceased patient are reborn as twins to a famous Japanese musical idol and navigate the highs and lows of the Japanese entertainment industry as they grow up together through their lives.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2024 · Lovely Runner
metas.description: Right after top star Ryoo Seon-jae ends his life, his top fan Im Sol somehow time-travels back to when they were in high school and tries to protect him. A fantasy romance unfolds where people who missed each other in time finally...

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2023 · Twinkling Watermelon
metas.description: "Sparkling Watermelon" will tell the story of a boy living a double life between a model student and a band member who gets to time slip and meets his 18-year-old father. The two will build friendships there.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · Bon Appetit, Your Majesty
metas.description: French chef Yeon Ji Yeong wins a top competition but mysteriously lands in Joseon Dynasty, where she must cook fusion royal cuisine for a tyrannical king with an extremely sensitive palate.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Marry My Husband
metas.description: A story about Ji-won who after being killed by her husband who had an affair with her best friend, goes back 10 years in the past and has a chance to change her fate.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · See You in My 19th Life
metas.description: Ban Ji-eun can remember all her past lives. When her previous life is cut short by a tragic accident, she sets out to reunite with a man named Moon Seo-ha whom she met in her 18th life.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2022 · Summer Time Rendering
metas.description: Due to the death of his childhood friend, Shinpei returns to his native home, but beneath the surface this island seems to hold some secrets.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · To Be Hero X
metas.description: A battle royale between superhumans takes place for the title of X, the most popular hero.
